summary: Backend-only regression + new-endpoint pass for Mission Velora v0.3. Expanded pytest suite to 65 tests across /app/backend/tests/test_velora_backend.py (updated existing 32) + /app/backend/tests/test_velora_v2.py (new 33 tests for this iteration's new endpoints). Injected user + session_token into Mongo (per test_credentials.md) for auth-gated routes. 65/65 passed against the public preview URL. New endpoints validated: /api/ shape (app=Velora, org=Mission Velora), /api/contact (missionvelora8@gmail.com + co_founders), /api/articles (28 items, category + q filters, detail body+links, 404), /api/explore countries (40 with fees_inr_lakhs/pr_friendly/best_majors/visa) & universities (933, tag=india returns 73 India-tagged unis), /api/explore/recommend (countries budget+PR scoring & universities India+CS), /api/news fresh=true (Gemini or fallback, both return items), /api/blueprint/reset (401 without token, flips onboarding_complete=false with token), /api/profile/picture PUT (auth + base64 persistence verified via /me), /api/vision-boards full CRUD (create/get/upsert/list/delete), /api/pregrad GET + PUT fun+formal (per-user unique upsert, 400 on bad mode), /api/planner category=daily (order auto-increments), category PATCH, /api/planner/reorder (verified new order in DB), /api/collections arbitrary kind='news' with payload + dedupe.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to 836 lines. Seed data now lives in seed.json (good), but models + all routers still inline — consider splitting into routers/ modules (auth, explore, planner, collections, vision_boards, pregrad, articles, news) before it exceeds ~1000 LOC.

In /api/explore/recommend, when kind='universities' and `country` matches, items still get scored 0 if no CS majors are present, but they can appear in top-25 only if any signal scored > 0. This is fine, but note the score threshold (score > 0) silently drops all zero-signal items — document this in the endpoint docstring so frontend doesn't expect a full list.

/api/blueprint/reset uses `update_one` on db.blueprints without matching any user_id filter — it sets reset_at/archived on ANY blueprint doc if there happens to be one shared. Currently OK because blueprints are per-user, but the write should be filtered by user_id explicitly to be safe. Reference: server.py:525-528.

/api/news `all_items[seed % len(all_items):] + all_items[: seed % len(all_items)]` after `if kind` filter can raise ZeroDivisionError if a rare kind filter yields no items. Consider guarding when `all_items` empty (already guarded via `if all_items else []`, so ok — but confirm behaviour with an invalid kind filter).
PregradPayload has `mode` field but the route also takes `mode` as path param and re-authoritative — the body `mode` is ignored. Minor: mark body `mode` as unused or drop it from PregradPayload.
